text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Late autumn in Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup had 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
It's strange, Alv's milestones always seem 
to be in Kyoto

It's strange, Alv's milestones always seem 
to be in Kyoto, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's a race I entered last year too, after 
all.
choice_data_list: My Make Debut was here too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it.
choice_data_list:
Don't remind me... Álfr's way with 
reporters—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Admire Groove-san! It's been quite 
a while!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Back then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected reunion took place with the 
reporter who had suddenly interviewed her 
on the day of her Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
As last year's champion, we'd love to hear 
it! Could you share your thoughts going 
into today? Yes, please! Wait, no comment 
this time—?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will win.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will win the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup and achieve back-to-back victories.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become the 'closest and strongest' 
ideal role model for the juniors standing 
here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Groove said something like that?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You've gotten quite bold with your 
words. Still... you must be, if you are to 
reach that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes wide open and watch.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year was a fresh start to break out 
of the dark. This year is a challenge 
toward a grand achievement for a new step 
forward. My mindset is unmistakably 
different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, watching over her now, there is 
no worry left in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove looks this way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will definitely come back victorious.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove! Wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Sweep? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho. A star on this year's Tiara 
route, hailed as a standard-bearer of the 
Triple Tiara. A formidable little witch of 
an Umamusume who also seized the Shuka 
Sho."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if you were last year's queen 
or whatever—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: First place this year is mine!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Still, I won't back down either.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I didn't ask how you feel!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The moment I decide I want the queen's 
throne, it's already mine!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave 'em all in the dust with my 
"Wind Spirit Magic"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Still, you shouldn't take it 
lightly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The reigning queen, Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're pretty fired up, aren't you? I 
thought you wouldn't react no matter what 
I said, so you really surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm the one who's gonna win, so 
don't you go crying when you lose!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Your name was on the race entry list.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Without you, even if I win back-to-back 
victories, I can't call myself a true 
queen. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You and I are incompatible, but we're the 
only two who have seen the "darkness of 
despair."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now—it feels like you're the one and only 
person I can truly connect with in a race.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so. Thanks to that, right 
now, I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I can see... the light of dawn.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The dawn's light...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even the pair of sparrows flying 
harmoniously in the morning light.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like you've found it: tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Let us dedicate our victory. To our 
precious people—with a 'smile.'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems going easy on people doesn't suit 
me. However—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: My desire to win won't lose to yours.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's a showdown. To decide which of us— 
is the true Queen of the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Let us compete. Just you and me, 
for all time.
